title: Upper Body Strength A
notes: Heavy compounds; add 2.5 kg when all sets hit top reps.

title: Lower Body Strength A
notes: Keep bracing tight; belt optional on top set.

title: Upper Body Hypertrophy
notes: Short rests on accessories; stop 1–2 reps shy of failure.

title: Push / Pull / Legs (PPL) - Push
notes: Warm up shoulders; keep last set close to failure.

title: PPL - Pull
notes: Straps allowed on top back sets. Control eccentrics.

title: PPL - Legs
notes: Focus on depth; don't rush setup on squats.

title: Minimalist Full Body (45 min)
notes: Superset accessories if the gym is busy.

title: Hotel Gym Circuit
notes: Use whatever dumbbells are available; keep HR up.

title: 5K Prep - Strength Day
notes: Keep it easy on legs if mileage is high this week.

title: Mobility + Core (20 min)
notes: Good for rest days. Breathe through dead bugs.

title: Kettlebell Conditioning
notes: EMOM style. Adjust bell to keep form crisp.

title: Beginner Full Body (Machines)
notes: Start light. Add reps before adding weight.

title: Powerbuilding - Day 1
notes: Top set + back-off sets. Log RPE honestly.

title: Powerbuilding - Day 2
notes: Keep squat tempo consistent; no grinder reps.

title: Glute & Hamstring Focus
notes: Prioritize hip hinge. Keep shins vertical on RDLs.

title: Shoulder Rehab + Stability
notes: Pain-free range only. Skip overhead work if sore.

title: Upper/Lower Split - Lower
notes: If low back is fried, swap RDL for ham curl.
